newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Army resumes supplies to troops on offensive into Tamil Tiger territory in northern Wanni region after repairing bridge blasted by guerrillas in Tuesday's fierce raid.
Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte visits troops who defended Thandikulam in Vavuniya in Tuesday's Tamil Tiger rebel raid in bid to raise morale.
Government troops are now in full control of Thandikulam following Tuesday's fierce attack by Tamil Tiger rebels.
Troops on offensive into Tamil Tiger rebel stronghold in the Wanni temporarily halt their advance amidst hurried efforts to consolidate Thandikulam defences breached by guerrillas in Tuesday's raid.
More than 400 Tamil Tiger rebels killed in raid on army defences in Vavuniya, military spokesman Brigadier Sarath Munasinghe says.
